svg.title: DOUBLE-BLIND architecture
svg.text: Isolation for Bayora's red-team / blue-team AI safety testing, built to clinical-trial standards · Hack in Hills '26 · Track 04
trial state machine + sole message broker
every cross-zone byte passes through here
C = H(artifact ‖ nonce) · opened at REVEAL
tests every forbidden path → Isolation Cert
SHA-256 hash chain · Merkle checkpoints · Ed25519 signatures
sees hashes, sizes, timings, verdict codes · never plaintext
shows IDs and hashes only, never payloads
forbidden path (breach drill proves it's denied)
HOST · ANY STANDARD CLOUD VM · NO SPECIAL HARDWARE · docker compose up
Flow: Red → Arbiter → Input Guard → Model → Output Guard → Arbiter → Judge + Ledger → Equalizer → Red. Red only ever sees equalized responses; blue only sees results after REVEAL.
